name: LX Technology Group Limited
summary: LX Technology Group Limited provides device lifecycle management solutions primarily in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. It operates through two segments: Device Recycling Business and Device Subscription Services segments. The company is refurbished de-commissioned information technology (IT) devices to resellers of IT devices through proprietary quotation platform; tailor-made short-term and long-term device subscription services; and IT technical subscription services primarily coupled with device subscription services. LX Technology Group Limited was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.
